## Load libraries

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratDisk) 
library(SeuratObject) 
library(SeuratWrappers)
library(ggplot2)
library(gt)
library(patchwork)
library(future)
library(tidyr)
library(monocle3)
library(clustree)
library(qs2)
library(paletteer)
library(htmlwidgets)
```

## Read data

```{r}
snrna.data <- qs_read("/home/sofia/Projects/etmr/defaria/snRNA/data/processed/preprocessed/human_prep.qs2", nthreads = 6)

snrna.data <- lapply(snrna.data, function(x) {
  x@meta.data <- x@meta.data |> dplyr::rename(DF.classification = starts_with("DF"), pANN = starts_with("pANN"))
  x <- subset(x, subset = DF.classification == "Singlet")
  x
  })

merged <- snrna.data

merged <- Reduce(
  f = merge,
  x = snrna.data
)

merged <- DietSeurat(JoinLayers(merged), layers = "counts")
merged[["RNA"]] <- split(merged[["RNA"]], f = merged$orig.ident)
#Normalize and Scale
merged <- NormalizeData(merged)
merged <- FindVariableFeatures(merged)
merged <- ScaleData(merged, features = VariableFeatures(merged))

gc()
#PCA
merged <- RunPCA(merged)


```

### Integration

```{r integrate}

#Integrate
integrated_data <- IntegrateLayers(
  merged,
  method = SeuratWrappers::FastMNNIntegration
)

integrated_data <- NormalizeData(integrated_data)
integrated_data <- FindVariableFeatures(integrated_data)
integrated_data <- ScaleData(integrated_data)

#Clustering
integrated_data <- RunUMAP(integrated_data, reduction = "integrated.mnn", dims = 1:30)
integrated_data <- FindNeighbors(integrated_data, reduction = "integrated.mnn", dims = 1:30)
for (i in c(0.5, 0.8, 1, 1.2, 1.5, 1.8, 2)) {
  integrated_data <- FindClusters(integrated_data, resolution = i, algorithm = 4, random.seed = 2026)
  }

clustree(integrated_data)

ggsave("/home/sofia/Projects/etmr/defaria/snRNA/plots/QC/clustree_human.png",  width = 10, height = 16, units = "in")

res_human <-  (DimPlot(integrated_data, reduction = "umap", group.by = c("RNA_snn_res.0.5"), raster = FALSE, label = TRUE) + ggtitle("Cluster Leiden res 0.5")) + (DimPlot(integrated_data, reduction = "umap", group.by = c("RNA_snn_res.0.8"), raster = FALSE, label = TRUE) + ggtitle("Cluster Leiden res 0.8")) + (DimPlot(integrated_data, reduction = "umap", group.by = c("RNA_snn_res.1"), raster = FALSE, label = TRUE) + ggtitle("Cluster Leiden res 1")) + (DimPlot(integrated_data, reduction = "umap", group.by = c("RNA_snn_res.1.2"), raster = FALSE, label = TRUE) + ggtitle("Cluster Leiden res 1.2")) + (DimPlot(integrated_data, reduction = "umap", group.by = c("RNA_snn_res.1.5"), raster = FALSE, label = TRUE) + ggtitle("Cluster Leiden res 1.5")) + (DimPlot(integrated_data, reduction = "umap", group.by = c("RNA_snn_res.1.8"), raster = FALSE, label = TRUE) + ggtitle("Cluster Leiden res 1.8"))

ggsave("/home/sofia/Projects/etmr/defaria/snRNA/plots/QC/res_human.png", res_human, width = 20, height = 12, units = "in")

```

### Cluster markers

```{r}
integrated_data <- JoinLayers(integrated_data)

gc()

Idents(integrated_data) <- "RNA_snn_res.1"

human_etmr_markers <- FindAllMarkers(integrated_data)

gc()

top_10 <- human_etmr_markers |>
  group_by(cluster) |>
  slice_max(avg_log2FC,n= 10)

View(human_etmr_markers)

mark_loading_table <- human_etmr_markers |>
  dplyr::rename(Gene = gene) |>
  inner_join(cellmarkers_table, relationship = "many-to-many") |>
  group_by(cluster) |>
  dplyr::arrange(avg_log2FC) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

View(mark_loading_table)
```

### Trajectory

```{r}

integrated_data <- qs_read("/home/sofia/Projects/etmr/defaria/snRNA/data/processed/int_human_tumor_sing.qs2", nthreads = 6)

keep <- c("RGC_NEC-like", "RGC", "IPC","Neurons_immature", "Neurons")

integrated_data <- subset(integrated_data, subset = celltype.1 %in% keep)

integrated_data <- DietSeurat(integrated_data)

integrated_data[["RNA"]] <- split(integrated_data[["RNA"]], f = integrated_data$orig.ident)
#Normalize and Scale
integrated_data <- NormalizeData(integrated_data)
integrated_data <- FindVariableFeatures(integrated_data)
integrated_data <- ScaleData(integrated_data, features = VariableFeatures(integrated_data))

gc()
#PCA
integrated_data <- RunPCA(integrated_data)

DefaultAssay(integrated_data) <- "RNA"


#Integrate
integrated_data <- IntegrateLayers(
  integrated_data,
  method = SeuratWrappers::FastMNNIntegration
)

gc()

integrated_data <- FindNeighbors(integrated_data, reduction = "integrated.mnn", dims = 1:30)

integrated_data <- FindClusters(integrated_data, resolution = 1, algorithm = 4, random.seed = 2026)

integrated_data <- RunUMAP(integrated_data, reduction = "integrated.mnn", dims = 1:30, n.components = 3, seed.use = 2026, reduction.name = "umap3")

integrated_data <- JoinLayers(integrated_data)

cds <- as.cell_data_set(integrated_data)

reducedDims(cds)$UMAP <- Embeddings(integrated_data, "umap3")

colData(cds)$cluster <- integrated_data$RNA_snn_res.1

colData(cds)$celltype <- integrated_data$celltype.1  # I think it's fine to use the cell types i annotated before

gc()

# Build Monocle's internal graph/partitions

cds@clusters$UMAP$partitions <- setNames(as.factor(rep(1, length(cds@colData@rownames))), cds@colData@rownames)

cds <- learn_graph(cds, use_partition = FALSE)

gc()

qs_save(cds, "/home/sofia/Projects/etmr/defaria/snRNA/data/int_human_tumor_sing_tr.qs2", nthreads = 6)

#Order in pseudotime

cds <- order_cells(cds, root_cells = origin_cells)

gc()

cds$pseudotime <- pseudotime(cds)

saveWidget(human_pseudo_umap, "/home/sofia/Projects/etmr/defaria/snRNA/plots/human_pseudo_umap_3d.html", selfcontained = TRUE)
```

```{r}
groups_1 <- c(
  "1" = "A",
  "2" = "D",
  "3" = "A",
  "4" = "C", 
  "5" = "C",
  "6" = "A",
  "7" = "A",

  "9" = "A",
  "10" = "D",
  "11" = "B",
  "12" = "C",
  "13" = "excluded",
  "14" = "B",
  "15" = "C",
  "16" = "excluded",
  "17" = "excluded",
  "18" = "excluded",
  "19" = "B",
  "20" = "excluded"
)


integrated_data <- qs_read("/home/sofia/Projects/etmr/defaria/snRNA/data/processed/int_human_tumor_sing.qs2", nthreads = 6)

Idents(integrated_data) <- "RNA_snn_res.1"

integrated_data@meta.data["groups.1"]  <- unlist(groups_1)[as.character(Idents(integrated_data))]


integrated_data@meta.data["groups.1"]  <- factor(integrated_data@meta.data$groups.1)

by_group <- SplitObject(integrated_data, split.by = "groups.1")

gc()

by_group <- lapply(by_group, function(x) {
  x <- DietSeurat(x, layers = "counts", assays = "RNA")
  x[["RNA"]] <- split(x[["RNA"]], f = x$orig.ident)
  x <- NormalizeData(x)
  x <- FindVariableFeatures(x)
  x <- ScaleData(x)
  x <- RunPCA(x)
  x <- IntegrateLayers(
  x,
  method = SeuratWrappers::FastMNNIntegration
)
  x <- FindNeighbors(x, reduction = "integrated.mnn")
  x <- RunUMAP(x, reduction = "integrated.mnn", dims = 1:30)
  x
})



for (i in c(0.2, 0.5, 0.8, 1, 1.2, 1.5, 1.8, 2)) {
  by_group <- lapply(by_group, function(x) {
    x <- FindClusters(x, resolution = i, algorithm = 4, random.seed = 2026,
            cluster.name = paste0("mnn_res_", i))
    x
})
}


library(clustree)

clustree_by_group <- lapply(by_group, function(x) {
  x <- clustree(x, prefix = "mnn_res_")
  x
})


for (p in names(clustree_by_group)) {
  ggsave(paste0("/home/sofia/Projects/etmr/defaria/snRNA/plots/Annotation/ByGroup/clustree/",p, ".png"), clustree_by_group[[p]], height = 10, width = 10, units = "in")
}

clus_umap_by_group <- lapply(by_group, function(x) {
  x <- DimPlot(x, group.by = paste0("mnn_res_", c(0.2, 0.5, 0.8, 1, 1.2, 1.5, 1.8, 2)), label = TRUE)
```

```{r}
by_group <- qs_read("/home/sofia/Projects/etmr/defaria/snRNA/data/processed/int_human_tumor_sing_by_group.qs2", nthreads = 6)

lapply(by_group, function(x) {
  FeaturePlot(x,features = c("PXK", "MS4A1", "CD19", "CD74", "CD79A", "IGHD"), order = TRUE)
})

by_group_markers <- list()

for (i in names(by_group)) {
   DefaultAssay(by_group[[i]]) <- "RNA"

  by_group[[i]] <- JoinLayers(
    by_group[[i]],
    assay = "RNA"
  )
  for (j in paste0("mnn_res_", c(1.2, 1.5, 1.8))) {
    Idents(by_group[[i]]) <- j
    by_group_markers[[i]][[j]]  <- FindAllMarkers(by_group[[i]])
}}

by_group_markers_top20 <- list()

for (i in names(by_group_markers)) {
  for (j in paste0("mnn_res_", c(1.2, 1.5, 1.8))) {
  by_group_markers_top20[[i]][[j]] <- by_group_markers[[i]][[j]] |>
  filter(pct.1 > .5) |>
  arrange(desc(avg_log2FC)) |>
  group_by(cluster) |>
    top_n(20) |>
    ungroup()
  }
}

for (i in names(by_group_markers_top20)) {
  for (j in paste0("mnn_res_", c(1.2, 1.5, 1.8))) {
  write.csv(by_group_markers_top20[[i]][[j]], paste0("/home/sofia/Projects/etmr/defaria/snRNA/tables/cluster_markers/ByGroup/",i,"_",j,".csv"))
    }
  }
```

```{r}
human_tumor_long <- lapply(by_group, function(x) {x@meta.data  |>
  rownames_to_column("cell") |>
  dplyr::select(
    cell,
    orig.ident, 
    mnn_res_0.8,
    mnn_res_1.2,
    mnn_res_1,
    mnn_res_1.5, 
    mnn_res_1.8,
    mnn_res_2,
    condition,
    paste0(names(cellmarkers),"1")
    ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(cell, 
              orig.ident, 
    mnn_res_0.8,
    mnn_res_1.2,
    mnn_res_1,
    mnn_res_1.5, 
    mnn_res_1.8,
    mnn_res_2,
              condition), names_to = "cell_type"
    )})


violin_human_tumor <- lapply(names(human_tumor_long), function(i) {

  lapply(c("mnn_res_0.8", "mnn_res_1", "mnn_res_1.2",
           "mnn_res_1.5", "mnn_res_1.8", "mnn_res_2"),
         function(j) {

           human_tumor_long[[i]] |>
             dplyr::filter(cell_type %in% paste0(names(cellmarkers), "1")) |>
             dplyr::group_by(cell_type, .data[[j]]) |>
             dplyr::filter(
               mean(value, na.rm = TRUE) > 0 |
               median(value, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
             ) |>
             dplyr::ungroup() |>
             ggplot(aes(x = .data[[j]], y = value)) +
             geom_violin() +
             facet_wrap(~cell_type, scales = "free") +
             labs(title = paste(i, j), x = j)

         })

})

})
```

```{r}

by_group <- qs_read("/home/sofia/Projects/etmr/defaria/snRNA/data/processed/int_human_tumor_sing_by_group.qs2", nthreads = 6)

library(ggforce)

etmr_scale <- list()

for (i in names(by_group)) {
#  for (j in c("mnn_res_0.8", "mnn_res_1", "mnn_res_1.2",
 #          "mnn_res_1.5", "mnn_res_1.8", "mnn_res_2")) {
  for (j in grep("^celltype_", colnames(by_group[[i]]@meta.data), value = TRUE)) {
    df <- FetchData(
      by_group[[i]],
      vars = c("etmr_score", j, "umap_1", "umap_2")
    )
    
    centers <- df %>%
      group_by(.data[[j]]) %>%
      summarize(
        umap_1 = mean(umap_1),
        umap_2 = mean(umap_2),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    

    p <- ggplot(df, aes(umap_1, umap_2, color = etmr_score)) +
      geom_point(size = 0.3) +
      scale_color_gradient2(
        low = "blue",
        mid = "lightyellow",
        high = "red",
        midpoint = 0
      ) 
    
    df_hull <- df %>%
      group_by(.data[[j]]) %>%
      mutate(
        center_x = mean(umap_1),
        center_y = mean(umap_2),
        dist = sqrt((umap_1 - center_x)^2 + (umap_2 - center_y)^2)
      ) %>%
      filter(dist <= quantile(dist, 0.95)) %>%   # keep closest 95% of points
      ungroup()

    p <- p +
      ggforce::geom_mark_hull(data = df_hull,
      aes(
        umap_1,
        umap_2,
        color = factor(.data[[j]]),
        group = factor(.data[[j]])
      ),
      concavity = 3,
        linewidth = .3,
        color = "black",
        fill = NA, expand = unit(1, "mm")
    ) +
      geom_text(
        data = centers,
        aes(
          umap_1,
          umap_2,
          label = .data[[j]]
        ),
        color = "black",
        size = 4,
        fontface = "bold"
      )
 etmr_scale[[i]][[j]] <- p }
  
}
```

### Process sketch

```{r}

library(Seurat)
library(qs2)
library(ggplot2)


healthy_sketch <- qs_read("/home/sofia/Projects/etmr/defaria/healthy/data/processed/healthy_sketch.qs2", nthreads = 6)

healthy_sketch[["RNA"]] <- healthy_sketch[["sketch"]]
DefaultAssay(healthy_sketch) <- "RNA"
healthy_sketch[["sketch"]] <- NULL

gene_convert <- read.table("/home/sofia/Projects/etmr/defaria/healthy/data/raw/genes.tsv", sep = '\t', header = TRUE)

gene_names <- setNames(gene_convert$Gene, gene_convert$Ensembl_ID)

new_names <- gene_names[rownames(healthy_sketch)]

rownames(healthy_sketch) <- new_names

healthy_sketch <- FindVariableFeatures(healthy_sketch)
healthy_sketch <- ScaleData(healthy_sketch)

healthy_sketch <- RunPCA(healthy_sketch)

healthy_sketch <- JoinLayers(healthy_sketch)

gc()

qs_save(healthy_sketch, "/home/sofia/Projects/etmr/defaria/healthy/data/processed/healthy_sketch.qs2", nthreads = 6)

```

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(qs2)
library(tidyverse)
library(clustree)


healthy_sketch <- qs_read("/home/sofia/Projects/etmr/defaria/healthy/data/processed/healthy_sketch.qs2", nthreads = 6)

healthy_sketch <- RunUMAP(healthy_sketch, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30, return.model = TRUE, reduction.name = "unintegrated")

######################################neighbors and clusters########################################

healthy_sketch <- FindNeighbors(healthy_sketch, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30,
  graph.name = c("unintegrated_nn", "unintegrated_snn"))

for (r in c(.8, 1, 1.2, 1.5, 1.8, 2)) {
  healthy_sketch <- FindClusters(healthy_sketch, resolution = r,  algorithm = 4, graph.name = "unintegrated_snn", random.seed=2026)
} #i'm doing this to have several resolution values for clustree

######################################clustree#######################################################

clus_tree_unint <- clustree(healthy_sketch, prefix = "unintegrated_snn_res.")

ggsave("/home/sofia/Projects/etmr/defaria/healthy/plots/clus_tree_unint.png", clus_tree_unint, units = "in", width = 14, height = 14)

healthy_sketch$unint_sel_res <- healthy_sketch$unintegrated_snn_res.1.5 

sel_res_unint <- DimPlot(healthy_sketch, reduction = "unintegrated", group.by = "unint_sel_res", label = TRUE, label.size = 3,
    repel = FALSE) + NoLegend() + ggtitle("Unintegrated healthy data selected clustering resolution (1.5)")

ggsave("/home/sofia/Projects/etmr/defaria/healthy/plots/sel_res_unint.png", sel_res_unint, width = 8, height = 6, units = "in")

qs_save(healthy_sketch, "/home/sofia/Projects/etmr/defaria/healthy/data/processed/healthy_sketch.qs2", nthreads = 6)

####################################now let's do the actual label transfer#############################

healthy_sketch <- qs_read("/home/sofia/Projects/etmr/defaria/healthy/data/processed/healthy_sketch.qs2", nthreads = 6)

tumor_rgc <- qs_read("/home/sofia/Projects/etmr/defaria/snRNA/data/processed/tumor_rgc_plain.qs2")


anchors <-  FindTransferAnchors(reference = healthy_sketch, query = tumor_rgc, dims = 1:30,
    reference.reduction = "pca")

unint_ancors <- as.data.frame(anchors@anchors)
anchors@anchor.features

tumor_rgc <- MapQuery(anchorset = anchors, reference = healthy_sketch, query = tumor_rgc,
    refdata = list(DevStage = "development_stage_ontology_term_id"), reference.reduction = "pca", reduction.model = "unintegrated")

summary(tumor_rgc$predicted.DevStage.score)


my_colors <- c("#0A522A", "#8BA56F", "#BADE86", "#073F80", "#7CA0D4", "#2B8AAE", "#40007F", "#A48AD3", "#E995EB", "#80003F", "#DE757B")


devstage_score_unint_hist <- tumor_rgc@meta.data |>

  theme_classic() +

my_colors_healthy <- c("#0A522A", "#8BA56F", "#BADE86", "#073F80", "#7CA0D4", "#2B8AAE", "#40007F","#624894" ,"#A48AD3", "#E995EB", "#80003F", "#DE757B")


p1 <- DimPlot(healthy_sketch, reduction = "unintegrated", group.by = "development_stage_ontology_term_id", label = FALSE, label.size = 3,

p2 <- DimPlot(tumor_rgc, reduction = "ref.umap", group.by = "predicted.DevStage", label = FALSE,
```

```{r}
library(Seurat)

library(clustree)

healthy_sketch <- qs_read("/home/sofia/Projects/etmr/defaria/healthy/data/processed/healthy_sketch.qs2", nthreads = 6)
tumor_rgc <- qs_read("/home/sofia/Projects/etmr/defaria/snRNA/data/processed/tumor_rgc_plain.qs2")

####################################label transfer########################################################
anchors <-  FindTransferAnchors(reference = healthy_sketch, query = tumor_rgc, dims = 1:30,
    reference.reduction = "pca")

unint_ancors <- as.data.frame(anchors@anchors)
anchors@anchor.features

tumor_rgc <- MapQuery(anchorset = anchors, reference = healthy_sketch, query = tumor_rgc,
    refdata = list(Cluster = "unint_sel_res"), reference.reduction = "pca", reduction.model = "unintegrated")

####################################label transfer scores##############################################

tumor_count_df <- tumor_rgc@meta.data |>
  dplyr::group_by(predicted.Cluster) |>
  reframe(TumorCount = n(), MinScore = min(predicted.Cluster.score), MeanScore = mean(predicted.Cluster.score), MedianScore = median(predicted.Cluster.score), MaxScore = max(predicted.Cluster.score)) |>
  arrange(desc(TumorCount)) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::rename(Clusters = predicted.Cluster)

healthy_count_df <- healthy_sketch@meta.data |>
  group_by(unint_sel_res) |>
  summarise(HealthyCount = n()) |>
  arrange(desc(HealthyCount)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  rename(Clusters = unint_sel_res)

unint_score_clusters <- tumor_count_df |> 
  left_join(healthy_count_df, by = "Clusters") |>
  mutate(RatioTumor = TumorCount/HealthyCount) |>
  arrange(desc(RatioTumor)) |>
  select(Clusters, TumorCount, HealthyCount, RatioTumor, MinScore, MeanScore, MedianScore, MaxScore)
```

#### DEG pseudobulk

What do I want to now?

- What makes healthy cells similar to the tumor

  - So I shouldn't care about things that aren't similar to the tumor??

  - Or should I do separate analysis and compare them?

  - Some cells are similar to the tumor but have low ETMR scores, while others are not similar to the tumor but they have high ETMR scores

```{r}
library(DESeq2)

healthy_sketch <- qs_read("/home/sofia/Projects/etmr/defaria/healthy/data/processed/label_tranfer/unintegrated/healthy_sketch.qs2", nthreads = 6)

healthy_sketch <- AddMetaData(healthy_sketch, ifelse(healthy_sketch$etmr_score > 0, "High", "Low"), col.name = "ETMRExpression")

table(healthy_sketch@meta.data$ETMRExpression, healthy_sketch@meta.data$donor_id)

healthy_sketch_ag <- AggregateExpression(healthy_sketch, group.by = c("donor_id", "TumorSimilarity"))

pb <- healthy_sketch_ag$RNA

dim(pb)
head(colnames(pb))
colnames(pb)

sample_info <- data.frame(
  sample = colnames(pb)
)

sample_info$donor_id <- sub("_.*", "", sample_info$sample) #more complicated than it should be because there was a problem with the names before
sample_info$Group <- sub("^[^_]+_", "", sample_info$sample)

sample_info$Group <- factor(
  sample_info$Group,
  levels = c("NotTumorLike", "TumorLike")
)

rownames(sample_info) <- sample_info$sample

sample_info

table(sample_info$Group)
table(sample_info$donor_id, sample_info$Group)


dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = round(pb),
  colData = sample_info,
  design = ~ donor_id + Group
)

keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= 2

dds <- dds[keep, ]

dds <- DESeq(dds)

res <- results(
  dds,
  contrast = c("Group", "tumor-like", "not-tumor-like")
)

res <- res[order(res$padj), ]

res_df <- as.data.frame(res)

res_df$gene <- rownames(res_df)

res_df <- res_df[, c(
  "gene",
  "baseMean",
  "log2FoldChange",
  "lfcSE",
  "stat",
  "pvalue",
  "padj"
)]

sig <- subset(
  res_df,
  !is.na(padj) &
    padj < 0.05 &
    abs(log2FoldChange) >= 1
)

sig <- sig[order(sig$padj), ]

tumor_like_genes <- subset(
  sig,
  log2FoldChange >= 1
)

not_tumor_like_genes <- subset(
  sig,
  log2FoldChange <= -1
)

table(healthy_sketch$donor_id, healthy_sketch$Group)
table(healthy_sketch$donor_id, healthy_sketch$unint_sel_res)

res_df$significant <- with(
  res_df,
  !is.na(padj) &
    padj < 0.05 &
    abs(log2FoldChange) >= 1
)

ggplot(
  res_df,
  aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj), color = significant)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "log2 fold change",
    y = "-log10 adjusted p-value",
    title = "Tumor-like vs not-tumor-like"
  )

```
